title: Tool 69 — DLT Privacy Model Selector
description: Decision-tree questionnaire (10 questions) recommending the optimal DLT privacy model: Fabric PDC, Fabric channels, Corda confidential transactions, Canton sub-transaction privacy, or Besu private transaction manager. Client-side. Works offline. Zero PII.
